mapper.sql: SELECT log_id, application_id, from_status, to_status, action, feedback, operator_id, operator_name, transition_time, review_mode, duration, client_ip, user_agent, metadata, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag FROM des_application_state_log
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_reviews, SUM(CASE WHEN to_status IN ('1', '3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as approved_count, SUM(CASE WHEN to_status IN ('2', '4') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rejected_count, SUM(CASE WHEN to_status = '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as withdrawn_count, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN to_status IN ('1', '3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN action IN ('ADMIN_REVIEW', 'ENTERPRISE_REVIEW') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2 ) as approval_rate, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN to_status IN ('2', '4') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN action IN ('ADMIN_REVIEW', 'ENTERPRISE_REVIEW') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2 ) as rejection_rate FROM des_application_state_log WHERE del_flag = '0' AND action IN ('ADMIN_REVIEW', 'ENTERPRISE_REVIEW', 'WITHDRAW')
AND transition_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
WHERE del_flag = '0' AND application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY transition_time DESC, log_id DESC LIMIT 1
